description: This PHP script handles the addition of product relationships to price books within the vtiger CRM system. It processes form data to insert records linking products or price books with their respective prices, and then redirects the user to appropriate views based on the context.

classes.name: CurrencyField
classes.description: A class providing currency-related utility functions, specifically for converting currency formats for database storage.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues like SQL injection.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the current parent tab from the context.

methods.name: getPriceBookCurrency
methods.description: Fetches the currency ID associated with a given price book.

methods.name: CurrencyField::convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Converts a currency value from user input format to database storage format.
